expertise.heading: A Comprehensive Approach to Space
expertise.intro: MBERRY BURO is an interior design bureau led by Olha Malinko. We develop concepts, layouts and technical solutions, coordinate specialists, and support projects through implementation.

services.title: Renovation & Reconstruction
services.text: Replanning and rebuilding existing spaces, from structural changes to final finishes.

services.title: Interior Design
services.text: Concepts, layouts, materials and lighting shaped around how you live or work.

services.title: Technical Documentation
services.text: Working drawings and specifications that contractors can build from.

services.title: Permits & Approvals
services.text: Coordinated with locally authorized architects, engineers and qualified specialists.

services.title: Procurement & FF&E
services.text: Furniture, fixtures and equipment selected, scheduled and ordered.

services.title: Design Supervision
services.text: Regular site oversight so the finished space matches the design.

expertise.note: Permits and regulated technical work are carried out in coordination with locally authorized architects, engineers and other qualified specialists.

process.heading: One Project. From the First Idea to a Finished Space.
process.text: We coordinate architecture, interiors, engineering, and construction as one project. The specialist team depends on the property, project scope, and local requirements.

packages.heading: Choose Your Way to Work
packages.sub: From one-off advice to comprehensive renovation and implementation support.
packages.footnote: Final pricing is determined after reviewing the property and project requirements. All listed prices are starting rates.
packages.help: Not sure which format suits your project? Share your floor plan, property size, photos, and a short brief. We’ll recommend the best approach.

items.name: Consultation
items.benefit: Professional guidance for a specific design challenge.
items.bestFor: Clients managing their own interiors who need expert input on a specific decision, room, or small apartment.
included: Advice on furniture, wall finishes, color, lighting, materials, and basic layout decisions.
Clear recommendations for the next step; a one-off session or occasional support throughout a project.
items.receive: Practical professional recommendations to make a particular decision with more confidence.

items.name: Design Project
items.benefit: A complete design package for self-managed implementation.
items.bestFor: Clients who want to arrange contractors and oversee implementation themselves, using a professionally prepared design package.
included: Concept development, space planning, and visualizations.
Working drawings; material, furniture, and lighting selections; specifications and procurement schedules.
items.receive: A coordinated set of design documentation and selections to share with contractors and suppliers.
items.note: The final fee depends on property size, complexity, and documentation scope. Additional hourly consultations can be booked during the client-managed implementation stage.

items.name: Comprehensive / Turnkey Project
items.benefit: A coordinated project cycle, from concept through implementation.
items.bestFor: Clients who need one coordinated team for design and implementation, especially when renovation, reconstruction, permits, or complex technical work is involved.
included: Concept, layouts, design and working documentation, plus coordination of engineering solutions.
Permit and approval coordination with locally licensed/authorized professionals where required.
Contractor and supplier selection/coordination, procurement, required connections as applicable, design supervision, and implementation support.
items.receive: A single point of coordination for the agreed scope, from design decisions to professional oversight of implementation.

items.name: Home Staging & Styling
items.benefit: Prepare a property for sale, rental, photography, or move-in.
items.bestFor: Apartment and house owners who want a more compelling presentation without a full renovation.
included: Furniture arrangement, spatial composition, lighting, textiles, decorative accessories, and styling.
Recommendations suited to the property’s immediate purpose and audience.
items.receive: A visually coherent, attractive space ready for presentation or use.

about.heading: Design Expertise Across Borders
about.text: Led by Olha Malinko, MBERRY BURO brings a considered design approach to private homes and commercial spaces. We adapt each project to the requirements of its location and coordinate relevant specialists through the delivery process.
